# ScalePods

> ScalePods designs, engineers, and deploys custom AI-powered workflow automation engines that eliminate operational friction, replace repetitive manual busywork, and help lean enterprises scale without headcount inflation.

ScalePods partners with ambitious businesses across the US, UK, UAE, and India to architect end-to-end intelligent systems combining conversational AI, automated data pipelines, computer vision, and autonomous agents.

## Core Solutions

- [Sales Workflow Automation](https://www.scalepods.co/solution/sales-workflow-automation): Autonomous revenue infrastructure connecting multichannel lead capture, sub-2-minute qualification (WhatsApp, SMS, Email, AI Voice), CRM synchronization, and intelligent follow-up loops.
- [HR & Talent Workflow Automation](https://www.scalepods.co/solution/hr-workflow-automation): Autonomous talent acquisition and onboarding systems featuring contextual AI resume parsing, candidate scoring, self-scheduling interview bots, and compliance workflows.
- [Marketing Workflow Automation](https://www.scalepods.co/solution/marketing-workflow-automation): Enterprise growth automation unifying multi-channel demand capture, dynamic content orchestration, maker-checker creative pipelines, and lifecycle email automation.
- [Operations & Process Workflow Automation](https://www.scalepods.co/solution/ops-workflow-automation): Centralized operational hubs automating supplier invoice reconciliation, 3-way PO matching, ERP/SAP connectivity, and real-time executive spend tracking.
- [Manufacturing AI Automation](https://www.scalepods.co/solution/ai-automation-for-manufacturing): Industrial automation for plant operations, real-time bill-of-materials reconciliation, logistics audits, and inventory anomaly detection.
- [Real Estate AI Automation](https://www.scalepods.co/solution/ai-automation-for-real-estate): Brokerage operating systems connecting sub-2-minute lead capture, milestone transaction coordination, agent recruiting, and 24/7 compliance coaching.

## Proven Enterprise Case Studies

- [Lotus Manor Real Estate (Dubai)](https://www.scalepods.co/case-study/lotus-manor-real-estate-sales-automation-dubai): Automated 7,000+ follow-ups across 1,000+ property prospects, driving 229 qualified buyer appointments.
- [ZV Steels (India)](https://www.scalepods.co/case-study/zv-steels-recruitment-automation-tool): Slashed recruiter screening effort by 80% with Claude-powered candidate evaluations and automated 3-way ERP invoice verification.
- [A Squared Real Estate (Dubai)](https://www.scalepods.co/case-study/asquared-real-estate-sales-automation-dubai): Triaged 22,000 dormant leads in 72 hours, extracting 30 high-intent property buyers via WhatsApp and AI Voice.
- [Lootah Group (Dubai)](https://www.scalepods.co/case-study/lootah-group-procurement-workflow-automation): Compressed purchase order batch ingestion from 45 minutes to under 2 minutes, eliminating supplier overpayments.
- [Macro Media (USA)](https://www.scalepods.co/case-study/macro-media-finance-workflow-automation): Rebuilt financial coordination, cutting month-end close coordination by 30% across accounting units.
- [Bennett Realty (USA)](https://www.scalepods.co/case-study/bennett-realty-growth-os): Sub-2-minute lead response and automated transaction tracking, saving 8–10 administrative hours per closing.
- [Victory Energy (USA)](https://www.scalepods.co/case-study/victory-energy-business-automation): Deployed four custom operating systems (Talent OS, Sales OS, Marketing OS, Financial OS) across 17 operating entities.
